findings: Design drift F3/P4: in an on tenant a rebind moves the old group's rows to the new group (and clears the target's own rows); the move is skipped only when ZERO rows move. The F3 shape needs a row-less admin group (A1 holds a user row); tests build it with userize_admin_row!/1. With a group row, the rebind to a group with a member is allowed (pinned).

P4 fail-closed: reconcile_binding! already reads the mode for a platform-to-platform move, so a rebind in an unreadable tenant raises regardless of the new guard; the bounded T-L8 'never reads the mode' claim cannot hold for a rebind, and the guard's own read there is unobservable (equivalent for MU-LA-8).
P8: deleting the populated admin group answers :not_found_or_has_members (bound_to_role is for a memberless bound group).

Windows checkout: mix test prints Result: N passed / N/M passed (no 'tests, failures' line); the repo static guard test/letflow/identity_login_directory_test.exs requires the literal login_directory: :skip (or :tenant_id) in the argument text of every update_user_status/update_user_profile call under test/.
